hash_algorithms.notation: U(x)=UTF8 of exact string with no normalization; D(n)=ASCII canonical base10 nonnegative integer without leading zeros except0; NUL=one0byte; H=SHA256 digest; hex=lowercase hex. hash_algorithms.choice: H(U(exp01-expand-v1)+NUL+D(global_seed)+NUL+D(stream_seed)+NUL+U(root_stream_symbol)+NUL+U(instance_symbol)+NUL+U(choice_name)). Interpret digest as unsigned big-endian integer and take modulo N over the declared ordered nonempty alternatives. No claim of statistically uniform sampling.

choice_names.slot: slot/ followed by the exact slot_name
choice_names.gap: gap/ followed by the exact anchor_id

hash_algorithms.choice_bounds: Integer interval choice uses N=max-min+1 and min+(Hinteger mod N), with exact Python integer intermediates and int64 checks on resulting gaps/times; never wrap. hash_algorithms.stream_order: Sort by (H(U(exp01-stream-order-v1)+NUL+D(global_seed)+NUL+U(generated_stream_id)) as raw digest bytes, then generated_stream_id ASCII bytes).
